t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Cat and Mouse
d: Deborah finds herself in a fairytale romance with bad boy Steven. But after they marry, Deborah becomes a subject to daily abuse. When she leaves him, Steven stops at nothing to get revenge.
Sherry Meinberg is living the innocent life of a teen in the 1950s when she meets handsome Chuck Gray. But the man of her dreams soon turns into a monster.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Nowhere to Run
d: After three years of emotional abuse, Peggy breaks it off with her boyfriend. But when he begins watching Peggy's every move, she has to take matters into her own hands.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: In the Spotlight
d: A well-respected TV news journalist in San Diego is stalked by a deranged fan who threatens rape and murder if she doesn't follow explicit instructions while on air.
K.T. Mills is a popular radio DJ with a friendly voice. But when one deranged listener becomes obsessed with the woman behind the mic, her life is turned upside down.
Linda is hoping for love when she meets Jim, but his charm lasts only as long as he doesn't drink. Unable to stay sober, Jim becomes determined to keep Linda all to himself...even if it kills her.
After Ann Moulds is bombarded with sadistic letters from an anonymous stalker, she tries to get help from police. But with no stalking laws in Scotland, she's at her stalker's mercy.

When a well-respected psychiatrist and his adult son are killed as they sleep, police are baffled by the apparent randomness-until an arrest in an unrelated crime leads them to the least likely of suspects.
When the bodies of Ruby Joyner and Halima Jones were discovered beaten, strangled, and shot, police turned to someone they both knew. The problem? That someone was nowhere to be found.
When Lisa Guy failed to show up for work after Thanksgiving weekend, a wellness check led to a nightmarish discovery and would hit close to home.
Successful Atlanta entrepreneur Lance Herndon usually got what he wanted.
When the wife of a wealthy Florida real estate developer is found dead in her bathroom, two theories emerge. Was her supposedly loving husband not so loving after all?
When Maggie Locascio is found brutally murdered in her Coral Gables home, everybody points to her estranged husband, Ed - even Ed's son.
In 2001, University of South Carolina student Shelton Sanders disappeared while planning a friend's bachelor party.

d: Makeva Jenkins, 33 and pregnant, was shot in her sleep. Police first suspected mistaken identity, but digital clues revealed a murder-for-hire plot by her husband, Euri Jenkins, to collect life insurance—unaware she’d made her mother the beneficiary.

d: Murder of Candice Cooper – A woman drowns on vacation with her boyfriend, who claims she was intoxicated. Investigators find no drugs but uncover his assault history. The coroner reveals she was strangled. He’s convicted of murder.

st: Crime Exposé with Nancy O'Dell - Season 1 - Episode 085
d: When Jessica Vecchiola stopped responding, her mother found her murdered by internal decapitation. Though road rage was first suspected, evidence led to her estranged husband Antonio, who took a plea deal and avoided jail.

st: Crime Exposé with Nancy O'Dell - Season 1 - Episode 095
d: Jayna Murray was murdered by coworker Brittany Norwood at a Lululemon store after catching her shoplifting. Brittany faked a robbery and injuries, but her story fell apart. She was sentenced to life in prison.

st: Crime Exposé with Nancy O'Dell - Season 1 - Episode 047
d: Murder of James Sheaffer – After James vanished, police questioned a neighbor whose name was on his bank account. She was arrested and confessed to killing him and cooking his body. She was convicted, leaving his family devastated.
A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.
The phone rings in the middle of the night. On the other end of the line, the sounds of an attack. The couple that receive the call rush to its source and discover a horrific scene.

In 1986, an American becomes one of Canada’s most prolific bank and jewellery bandits after he pulls off one of the biggest heists in Canadian history. As more robberies occur, the police become more determined to catch the mastermind behind them all.
Surgically clean body parts start turning up on a highway. Stranger still, they have been drained of every drop of blood.

A frat boy lures a girl to his house with the promise of a party, but once there it turns out he has ulterior motives. When the girl says no, he violently attacks her. A string of violence is finally uncovered, revealing a sinister trail of violence.
A trucker at a roadside rest station discovers the fully clothed body of a dead East Indian woman.

In 1988, a promiscuous 22-year old boy from the Sikh community has one affair too many and ends up losing his life. Diligent detective work and DNA help police nail the killer who believed he had gotten away with murder.
A woman is told by a friend that she was a passenger in a car where she was confronted with a guy's head in a bucket.
A string of bank robberies in Winnipeg confound local police. Most bank-robbers are addicts, usually quite thin. This new man doesn't fit the profile: this bandit is fat.
A wealthy Asian girl is kidnapped in Vancouver. When the kidnappers make the fateful error of using the young girl’s cell phone, police are able to track their movements and capture the assailants.
The bizarre murder of a world-renowned anthropologist over the Christmas holidays shocks staff and students at the university where she teaches.
A real estate broker doesn’t return home. Her family can't find her. But police do - dead in a closet in her office. The DNA on her body is tested against 150 men. No match. The case runs cold.
